tasks.instruction: Wykorzystujac slowa podane wielkimi literami, uzupelnij luki w zdaniach tak, aby zachowac sens zdania wyjsciowego. W kazda luke mozesz wpisac do 6 wyrazow lacznie z wyrazem podanym. Nie wolno zmieniac form podanych slow. Niedopuszczalne sa formy skrocone (isn't, won't, would've itd.). Wymagana jest pelna poprawnosc gramatyczna i ortograficzna.

items.original: Would you like to have some ice cream?
We have arranged to meet in the city centre at 5 p.m.
items.transformed: We _________ 5 p.m. in the city centre.

items.original: When I was younger, I dyed my hair green every summer.
items.transformed: When I was younger, I _________ green.

items.original: After he reached the foot of the mountain, he realised that he didn't have his mobile.
items.transformed: He _________ the foot of the mountain when he realised he didn't have his mobile.

items.original: Jack collected his diploma and then we left the ceremony.
items.transformed: We didn't leave the ceremony _________ his diploma.
items.answer: until Jack collected / until Jack had collected

items.original: Mary and John are both 15 years old.
Take your umbrella, Susie, because it might rain in the evening.
items.transformed: Take your umbrella, Susie, _________ in the evening.

items.original: Although she tries hard, she never manages to finish marathons.
items.transformed: She never manages to finish marathons _________ she tries.

items.original: You will never lose weight if you don't exercise more regularly.
items.transformed: You won't lose weight _________ more regularly.
